name: Acherontic-Inselberg
description: A single unbroken ocean swallows the horizon, its color shifting from wine-dark deeps to bright shelf-teal. The only interruptions are frozen methane lakes, breaking the swell in a ragged arc.

The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking. Something scrubbed this biosphere clean within a geological instant. The rocks remember it as a thin black line.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
